messages:
anya: deploy-bot auto-throttled v3.11.0 for /embeddings (p95 +55%). It suggested autorevert but we should decide: immediate rollback, tenant pin, or try a 10min hotpatch of the quant kernel? Also: change-window implications if we do a hotpatch now?

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout throttled to 20% for v3.11.0. Trigger: embeddings_p95_delta >= 50% (5m). Suggested actions: wait 10m; route-split to stable; manual rollback to v3.10.7; enable autorevert in 12m.

ops-oncall: I'm online. Given magnitude (+55%) i'd prefer: 1) suppress autorevert, 2) tenant-scoped pins for top-traffic tenants to reduce blast, 3) attempt hotpatch only if devops confirms patch is low-risk and can be rolled back quickly. If hotpatch fails, manual rollback to v3.10.7.

devops: quick check: the change in v3.11.0 touched the tensor packer and quant kernel selector. We have a narrow hotpatch that toggles fallback kernel heuristics. I can stage it; risk low but needs a restart on a small slice. Can do in ~8m.

lena: support standby: prepare a short customer note template and update the status page if we pin/rollback. Also prepare an internal FAQ for support tickets.

product: flagging release notes impact — if we hotpatch we should still note a perf regression in the release notes and link the rollback/hotpatch timeline. legal: want to review customer wording.

legal: quick read: keep wording non-technical and avoid absolutes. Suggest: "We observed higher latency on embeddings for some customers and have applied mitigations while we investigate. No changes to customer data."

anya: plan proposal: devops to run tenant-pin for top 3 tenants now, suppress autorevert, then apply hotpatch to a 5% canary for 10m. If p95 for canary < +15% improvement -> expand hotpatch; if not -> rollback tenants to v3.10.7 and pin for 24h. Ops to call the rollback.

devops: executing tenant pins now for tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c: ` /deploy pin --tenant tenant-a --version v3.10.7 && /deploy pin --tenant tenant-b --version v3.10.7 && /deploy pin --tenant tenant-c --version v3.10.7 `

deploy-bot: [system] Autorevert suppressed by operator request for thread 4805554321. Autorevert paused until 4805559999.

devops: pins applied and verified. now applying hotpatch to 5% canary slice (kernel-heuristic toggle). restart sequence in progress. logs: ```[hotpatch] canary-start tenant-slice=5% nodes=4; restart ok; probe p95 sampling...```

ops-oncall: watching telemetry. if canary p95 doesn't improve by >25% within 10m, we rollback. rollback command staged: `/deploy rollback --service=embeddings --to v3.10.7 --scope tenant=<id> --reason "perf regression v3.11.0"`

lena: support note drafted using legal wording. ready to publish if we pin or rollback. Also prepping an opt-in message for high-traffic customers explaining the pin.

product: posted a short internal release-note draft linking to this thread. will wait for final outcome before customer announcement.

devops: canary 6m in: p95 on canary improved ~30% vs v3.11.0 slice, tail looks better, no 5xx. trending ok.

ops-oncall: good signal. continue canary run to 12m, then expand to 20% if stable. rollback threshold still > +25% vs baseline.

anya: thanks. if we expand and metrics hold, we should still keep tenant pins for 12-24h and schedule a follow-up postmortem to root-cause the quant change. I'll update the change-window calendar to mark a short maintenance slot tomorrow in case we need a coordinated reroll.

support: confirm FAQ updated and standby for customer pings. ready to publish customer-facing note once product gives the go. :white_check_mark:

product: will approve the note if the canary stays healthy at 20m. tagging this thread for the release notes entry and postmortem action item.

ops-oncall: last check t+20m (4805554390): canary stable, p95 within +10% of baseline. expanding hotpatch to 20% now. schedule: ramp over 15m, keep pins for 24h. closing decision: hotpatch accepted, rollback not executed.

anya: closing loop: hotpatch accepted, tenant pins remain for 24h, postmortem scheduled. will post a customer update after legal signoff. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
